lines.zh: 我提着一点绿光飞过草尖。
lines.en: I carry a green spark over the grass tips.
My wings hum softer than a breath.

lines.zh: 夜路是我一条条点亮的。
lines.en: I light the night paths one by one.
I bend low over the water's surface.
The leaves close behind me.
I fly slowly; my light arrives first.
Dew has weighed my wings down.
I drift forward along the fence line.
I know every gap in the undergrowth.
Bright, dim, bright; I am counting steps.
My glow throws a small circle under leaves.
When the wind rises, I drop lower.
I round the web without touching a thread.
The whole marsh flickers along with me.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪水飞，水面替我照路。
lines.en: I fly along the creek; the water lights my way.

lines.zh: 我停在一片叶子上，喘口气。
lines.en: I rest on a leaf to catch my breath.
I rest my wings on a foxtail stalk.

lines.zh: 光慢慢暗下去，又亮起来。
lines.en: The light sinks, then rises again.
I count the frogs calling far away.
A tiny me glows inside a dewdrop.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，只剩一点绿。
lines.en: I fold my wings to a single green point.
The night is cool; the light shows clearer.
A moth has flown the wrong way.
I hold my glow steady at one setting.

lines.zh: 草叶替我挡了半小时风。
lines.en: A blade of grass has blocked the wind for me.
Who is watching me from the dark?
I do not sleep; I only slow down.

lines.zh: 我的肚子亮得像小灯芯。
lines.en: My abdomen glows like a small wick.

lines.zh: 你的脸被我的光照绿了。
lines.en: My light turns your face green.
You reach out; I rise a little higher.
I circle past the edge of your shoulder.
Your eyes keep chasing me.
Do not swat; I have six points of life.
I perch on your hat brim for a moment.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是汗和铁。
lines.en: You smell of sweat and iron.
I know you are waiting for full dark.

lines.zh: 我的光映在你眼里一点。
lines.en: A speck of my light sits in your eye.
I circled you two and a half times.
Who touched the base of my wing?
My light skipped a beat.
I drop to a leaf and climb back.
Do not step; I am on the ground.
The pain makes me switch off.
A small corner is missing from my wing.
I shake, and the glow steadies.
My memory is short, but not for this.
I shrink deeper into the grass.
I am flying a little crooked now.
Is that sugar water or rotting leaves?
Sweetness drifts up from your palm.
I only want one small sip.
I have never refused nectar.
Put the lamp out and I will come.
I circle that bit of sweetness.
A ripened fruit is calling me.
I land, then lift off at once.

lines.zh: 湿泥里的甜最对我胃口。
lines.en: The sweetness in wet soil suits me best.
A little closer and I will trust you.
Do not touch my wings with your nose.
Your sleeve knocked me off course.
One bump scatters me into two sparks.
I am light as a flake of ash.

lines.zh: 你走过带起的风推着我。
lines.en: The wind of your passing pushes me.
I swerve, and not from fear.
My shell is thin; please make room.
Hit me and you will see star specks.
I cling to a stem to let you pass.
Do not swat me down like a spark.
I search for her at my brightest setting.
She flashed back three times.
We circle the same stalk together.
Our lights matched, and that was enough.
The answers in the dark are brief.
I settle on the leaf beside her.
We drift, one high, one low.
Her glow runs yellower than mine.
That corner of the marsh is ours.
Before dawn, we will part.
You have cupped me in your palm.

lines.zh: 我停在你的指节上发光。
lines.en: I glow on your knuckle.
It is too airless inside a glass bottle.
Gently; my wings will crease.
Where are you carrying me?

lines.zh: 我顺着你的手指往上爬。
lines.en: I climb up along your finger.
Put me back in the grass, now.
Your hand is warmer than the night.

lines.zh: 我在你掌心留了一点光。
lines.en: I leave a little light in your palm.
When you lift me, do not pinch.
Something is moving under the leaves.
My glow dims by one notch.
That shadow is too big for an insect.
A thread of web trembles in the wind.
I hear footsteps in the wet soil.
I climb higher, away from the low ground.
A bat hangs upside down in the tree.
I kill my light and hide under a leaf.
That tongue is far too long.
I do not attack; I only hide.
I watch that wavering edge.
The whole grass field has gone quiet.
I hover, wings shivering.
Move, and I rise.
My light has become a target.
I try left; you are left too.
Six points of life; one hit ends it.
I shrink into a very small point.
A crack in the bark can hide me.
I count the sound of your breathing.
Any closer and I go dark and flee.
The night gives me too many shadows.
I start rising, and keep rising.

lines.zh: 你抓不到会发光的东西。
lines.en: You cannot catch something that glows.
I bump you, light as falling ash.
My attack is a single itch.
I butt the tip of your nose.
You did not even feel that.
My anger turns the light white.
I buzz circles around your ear.
I fan your face with my wings.
This is not a fight; it is a protest.
I strike, then retreat behind a leaf.
I am small; this is all the fierceness I have.
In the night marsh, I light up.
I crawl out of the rotting leaves.
My first breath carries damp.
The grass is much, much taller than me.

lines.zh: 我看见一整条河的月光。
lines.en: I see a whole river of moonlight.
My wings are still soft.
I try my first flicker.
There is a light far off, but not like mine.

lines.zh: 这片暗处需要一个亮点。
lines.en: This dark place needs one bright point.
I settle on the tallest grass tip.

lines.zh: 火一近，我的光就不算数了。
lines.en: Up close, fire makes my light worthless.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，翅没接住我。
lines.en: I fell from high, and my wings failed.

lines.zh: 水面盖过我，光在水下暗了。
lines.en: Water closes over me; my light dims below.
The blast flips me half a turn.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我旁边的叶。
lines.en: An arrow tears through the leaf beside me.
Potion mist turns my glow blue.
Without nectar my light grows weaker.
The lightning is ten thousand times brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我无处可停。
lines.en: In the void there is no grass to rest on.
